gloss: to squeeze out; to extract; to milk

definitions.gloss: to squeeze out; to extract; to press out
definitions.explanation: To extract liquid or essence from something by applying pressure. Used for juicing fruit, pressing oil, extracting flavor, etc.
To draw milk from a cow or other animal.

examples.japanese: {果汁|かじゅう}を{搾|しぼ}ってジュースを{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To squeeze out the juice and make a drink.

examples.japanese: オリーブから{油|あぶら}を{搾|しぼ}る{方法|ほうほう}は{古代|こだい}から{伝|つた}わっている。
examples.english: The method of extracting oil from olives has been passed down since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {牛|うし}の{乳|ちち}を{搾|しぼ}る。
{毎朝|まいあさ}、{牧場|ぼくじょう}で{乳|ちち}を{搾|しぼ}る{作業|さぎょう}がある。
examples.english: Every morning, there is the task of milking at the farm.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}を{使|つか}って{一度|いちど}に{何十頭|なんじゅっとう}もの{牛|うし}から{乳|ちち}を{搾|しぼ}ることができる。
examples.english: Using machines, it is possible to milk dozens of cows at once.

notes: Distinguished from the homophone {絞|しぼ}る, which means 'to wring' (like a towel) or 'to narrow down' (choices). {搾|しぼ}る focuses on extracting liquid or essence by pressing, while {絞|しぼ}る focuses on twisting or constricting. Common collocations: {果汁|かじゅう}を{搾|しぼ}る (squeeze juice), {乳|ちち}を{搾|しぼ}る (milk), {油|あぶら}を{搾|しぼ}る (press oil). Godan verb conjugating with る.
